blocks.text: NICE STORY. EXCEPT THAT IN 1911, COHEN WAS IN PRISON.
HIS BIOGRAPHER SAYS IT: ALMOST EVERYTHING COHEN SAID ABOUT HIMSELF IS FALSE, OR INFLATED.
ALMOST EVERYTHING. WHAT'S LEFT IS ENOUGH TO MAKE A LIFE.
AND THE MAN WAS NO SAINT, I SUPPOSE.
NOT AT ALL. BUT HE HAD LIVED ENOUGH REAL ADVENTURES FOR PEOPLE TO BELIEVE THE FAKE ONES TOO.
